svg.title: Two tries that do not close
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of two tries at a triangle that do not close, each three sides of 20 cm with a different turn. With Turn 90 the robot draws three sides of a square and stops, having turned 270 degrees in total. With Turn 60 it draws a wide open zig-zag, having turned only 180 degrees. A box beside it names each side and corner and keeps a running total of the degrees turned, and a note says that a closed shape needs 360 degrees of turning in all.
svg.text: Two tries that do not close
Watch the running total. To end facing
the way it started, the robot has to
turn all the way around: 360 degrees
by the last corner. What does each of

g.text: Turn 90: three sides of a square
